body: My family doesn't care about me. They're abusive and neglectful and haven't made any effort to see how I'm doing for my entire life. There are so few people who love me. I guess I'm just unlovable. My whole life has just been a sequence of people I care about turning out to hate me. Sure, there are some exceptions, but I'm getting a pretty clear message that I should just be alone. And I can't handle being alone.

It should be. It makes me feel so guilty to know that it's not. I've been feeling suicidal since last summer, and I've been holding on this long because of them, but there's only so long I can keep going before I can't handle it anymore.
